items.name: Meridian Media Group
items.description: Fictional multi-platform media conglomerate. Parent company of all publisher brands below. Modeled after major diversified media companies.

items.name: Apex Streaming / Apex Sports
items.description: Premium CTV/streaming platform with live sports (basketball, hockey) and scripted series. Think premium sports + entertainment streaming.

items.name: SportsPulse
items.description: Live sports broadcast network covering basketball, hockey, and combat sports across linear TV and digital.

items.name: GNN (Global News Network)
items.description: 24/7 news network with linear TV, digital video, podcasts, and display. Premium news-engaged audience.

items.name: Crestline Entertainment
items.description: Entertainment and lifestyle programming — reality TV, comedy, drama. Linear + CTV distribution.

items.name: Horizon Discovery
items.description: Digital-first media brand covering sports, science, and culture. Display and digital video inventory.

items.name: StreamVault
items.description: Online video platform with sports content, shorts, and gaming/esports programming.

items.name: PulseFight
items.description: Combat sports and boxing premium CTV content.

items.name: Atlas Media Group
items.description: Global agency holding company. Media buying, planning, and campaign management.

items.name: Pinnacle Media
items.description: Agency group specializing in data-driven media investment and programmatic.

items.name: Meridian Agency Partners
items.description: Full-service agency network with creative, media, and performance marketing.

items.name: Compass Media
items.description: Agency group focused on integrated marketing and cross-channel planning.

items.name: Horizon Agency Group
items.description: Global agency network with strength in digital and performance media.

items.name: Acme Consumer Goods
items.description: CPG company — energy drinks, protein bars, sports nutrition. Targets active lifestyle consumers.

items.name: Premier Motors
items.description: Luxury automotive brand. High-HHI audience, Pacific Northwest focus.

items.name: SportCo Retail
items.description: Sporting goods retailer. Seasonal campaigns, performance-focused.

items.name: SecureBank Financial
items.description: Financial services — premium checking, wealth management. High-income professionals.

items.name: CTV (Connected TV)
items.description: Premium video on streaming devices. Highest CPMs ($35-55). Live sports and scripted series.

items.name: Linear TV
items.description: Traditional broadcast. News, sports, entertainment. CPMs $22-32.

items.name: Digital Video (OLV)
items.description: Pre-roll, mid-roll, outstream on web properties. CPMs $15-20.

items.name: Display
items.description: Banner, rich media, homepage takeovers. CPMs $10-18.

items.name: Audio
items.description: Podcast sponsorships and programmatic audio. CPMs $8-10.

items.name: Apex Premium Sports Bundle
items.description: Basketball + Hockey CTV on Apex Sports. CPM $42-55. Sports enthusiasts 18-54.

items.name: GNN News Reach Package
items.description: GNN linear + digital + display. CPM $18-28. News-engaged adults 25-64.

items.name: Entertainment Upfront Package
items.description: Apex series + Crestline entertainment. CPM $35-48. Entertainment seekers 18-49.

items.name: Cross-Platform Reach
items.description: All channels combined. CPM $15-45. Volume discount at $500K+.

items.name: Public (0% discount)
items.description: Unauthenticated — browse catalog and price ranges only. Cannot create deals.

items.name: Registered Buyer (5%)
items.description: Authenticated DSP seat. Can create deals at 5% discount.

items.name: Preferred Agency (12%)
items.description: Agency-level identity. 12% discount, negotiation eligible.

items.name: Strategic Advertiser (15%)
items.description: Advertiser identity revealed. Best rates at 15% discount.
